name: Team model: she leads and works with you, no commands
She never walks off an edge, gets stuck or gets left behind
A level only completes with her beside you
Hold the door: she holds it, you let her through
The narrow way: the slot is hers, the ledges are yours
Light gate: her light and your lantern each hold a door
The watcher: a searchlight she draws while you cross
The fragile floor: she leads and breaks it, you go round
The crossing: rebuilt so she can follow every beat
